items.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) -
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    ROUND(pct_increase, 2) AS percentage_increase,
    CASE 
        WHEN pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct) THEN 'biggest'
        WHEN pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct) THEN 'lowest'
    END AS label
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

  FROM Patient

    WHEN outpatient_count > inpatient_count THEN 'outpatient'

        Birthday,
        Description,
        (strftime('%Y', "First Date") - strftime('%Y', Birthday) -

    WHERE UPPER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%SJS%'

    age_at_arrival

LIMIT 1;

items.question: Calculate the percentage whereby Hamilton was not at the 1st track of the the f1 circuit since 2010.
items.author: team

B2.sql:
WITH first_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2010 AND round = 1
),
hamilton_participated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ds.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM first_races)
),
total_first_races AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM first_races
),
participated_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hamilton_participated
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * (total - cnt) / total, 2) AS percentage_not_at_first_track
FROM total_first_races, participated_count;

    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p.publisher_name
)

items.question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.

items.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_diff_value
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

B1.sql:
WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_diff_value
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

B2.sql:
WITH locally_funded AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode,
           f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll_k12,
           f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enroll_5_17,
           (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff_value
    FROM locally_funded
)
SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.DOCType
FROM locally_funded lf
JOIN schools s ON lf.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff
WHERE lf.diff > avg_diff.avg_diff_value
ORDER BY school_name;

B3.sql:
WITH locally_funded AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode,
           f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll_k12,
           f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enroll_5_17,
           (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff_value
    FROM locally_funded
)
SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.DOCType
FROM locally_funded lf
JOIN schools s ON lf.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff
WHERE lf.diff > avg_diff.avg_diff_value
ORDER BY school_name;

    SELECT CDSCode, MAX(`Academic Year`) AS latest_year

)

    s.School AS school_name,
    s.District AS district_name,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate

items.question: Who are the account holder identification numbers whose who have transactions on the credit card with the amount is less than the average, in 1998?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH avg_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id AS account_holder_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND t.amount < (SELECT avg_amount FROM avg_1998)
ORDER BY account_holder_id;

B1.sql:
WITH avg_amount AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id AS account_holder_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
CROSS JOIN avg_amount
WHERE substr(t.date, 1, 4) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < avg_amount.avg_amt
ORDER BY account_holder_id;

B3.sql:
WITH avg_trans_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.type = 'credit'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (SELECT avg_amount FROM avg_trans_1998);
